depiction.primary_object: two overlapping checkmarks with one split into two strokes

readings.meaning: read receipt / message read or delivered
mark all as done / complete all

ambiguity: In a to-do list, a double checkmark looks like the task completion status indicator itself rather than a task topic, or can be confused with a single checkmark.
task_intents: confirm all items are accounted for

example_tasks.task: Double-check luggage weight limits on the regional connecting flight
Verify every line item on the contractor's final invoice before paying
Run through the release readiness checklist with QA
Cross-check kids' immunization records against the summer camp requirements
Verify domain DNS records have propagated across all regions
Tick off the remaining compliance items
Go through the whole list one more time
Double-check that the tax return includes both 1099 forms from the freelance gigs
Verify all emergency contact phone numbers on the school enrollment forms are current
Cross-verify the dosage instructions on the new prescription with the pharmacist before starting

example_tasks_es: Revisar dos veces los datos bancarios antes de enviar la transferencia
Verificar que todas las ventanas y puertas queden bien cerradas antes de salir
Confirmar la lista final de invitados con el salón
example_tasks_ru: Перепроверить реквизиты счёта перед отправкой оплаты
Сверить итоговый список вещей перед выездом в аэропорт
Пройтись по чек-листу сдачи квартиры с хозяином

context_tasks.task: Turn off WhatsApp read receipts on work phone
Implement message delivery and read status indicators in chat view
Notarize affidavit of residency at the credit union
Enable two-step verification on primary Google account

near_misses.task: Check the mailbox for the replacement debit card
Check on the sourdough starter before bed
Order a new checkbook from the credit union
Buy a checkered tablecloth for the backyard picnic
Schedule annual mole check at the dermatologist
Send a verified-mail receipt for the lease termination letter

reasoning: The double checkmark is a standard UI glyph for 'mark all complete', 'completed', or 'read receipt'. In a to-do list app it visually clashes with the task completion checkbox itself and represents a generic action ('check', 'verify') rather than a concrete task subject.
